data.content: The Albanian national team was preparing with great enthusiasm and dedication for the 2026 World Cup qualifiers, eagerly awaiting the big moment of international challenges that would begin in the largest stadiums of the world.

As always, this was a golden opportunity to showcase ourselves on the international stage. However, in order to be ready and to give life to that great match, it was necessary for the new jerseys to be ready, tailored for this sacred mission.
With much love, passion, and dedication, we got to work designing our jersey, aiming not only to give it the most beautiful look but also to honor the symbols of our nation.
For us, this was more than just a design project – it was an expression of love for our team, for our fans, and for Albania.
The fanelles come in three colors: red, white, and black. They reflect a vibrant history of Albanian identity and culture, with the eagle as the main motif.
This eagle holds high the historic courage of Skanderbeg, reminding us of our deepest traditions, with the opponent in the middle, facing the eyes of the eagle.

An eagle that symbolizes the heart, unity, pride, a bit of cunning, and a deep passion for our players, the modern heroes who come from all corners of the world to represent Albania with pride in every challenge on the field.
A team that is strongly united, a spirit that is full, a nation that will always remain proud. We are very happy that our boys will wear this jersey, even if just a little motivation.
